underlying_goal: Understand a transient EBUSY error, then resume and monitor a stalled VEX RAG pipeline that was interrupted by the crash
friction_detail: Claude started a redundant Episode-2-only script before discovering the original pipeline process was still alive and running from a previous session.
brief_summary: User needed to understand an EBUSY crash, then resume and monitor a VEX RAG pipeline from where it stalled; Claude diagnosed the issue, recovered the pipeline, and provided ongoing status checks.
